_comment: Panel colour presets (FM1-VST-PLAN.md 4.8). base / membrane / knob are the three user-facing colours; bed is the recessed plate the keys sit in (derived from membrane when absent). Sampled as 7x7 medians from the product photos in reference/MVaveOfficialColors on 2026-10-07; photo lighting shades them, so phase 3 tunes each by eye against its photo. 'emulator' is the ChoralRoot emulator's own palette (tools/emu/emu.c C_PLATE / C_CAP / knob cap).

presets.name: Black
presets.note: the photo's body reads #646464 under studio light; the unit is near-black, so base is darkened to match the bed
